entities.summary: Islamic University, Bangladesh, commonly referred to as Islamic University, Kushtia, is a public PhD granting research university in Jhenaidah-Kushtia, Bangladesh and the largest seat of higher education in the southwestern part of the country. This is the sole institution in the country offering a unique program in Theology, alongside seven other academic divisions/faculties: Engineering and Technology, Humanities, Social Sciences, Sciences, Biological Sciences, Business Administration, and Law, all coexisting within a diverse and multicultural environment.
